mapper.select: SELECT id, cust_no, cust_name, status, deleted, statis_dt, created_time, updated_time FROM CUST_MASTER WHERE cust_no = #{custNo} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO CUST_MASTER (id, cust_no, cust_name, status, deleted, statis_dt, created_time) SELECT REPLACE(UUID(), '-', ''), t.cust_id, t.cust_name, 'ACTIVE', 0, #{statisDt}, NOW() FROM ( SELECT s.CUST_ID AS cust_id, s.CUST_NAME AS cust_name FROM XAN_M98_CUST_STAT_SHOW3 s WHERE s.STATIS_DT = #{statisDt} AND s.CUST_ID IS NOT NULL AND s.CUST_ID <> '' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CUST_MASTER m WHERE m.cust_no = s.CUST_ID AND m.deleted = 0 ) GROUP BY s.CUST_ID, s.CUST_NAME ) t
